TITLE:
Tipsy Ryokan Sake Portrait

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Instagram-style lifestyle photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin texture.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Dark brown hair loosely tied back with soft see-through bangs and loose face-framing strands.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin with naturally flushed cheeks.

BODY:
Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Natural feminine curves.
Realistic anatomy.

OUTFIT:
White Japanese yukata with dark navy floral patterns.
Deep, naturally loosened V-shaped collar.
One shoulder largely exposed as the yukata has casually slipped down.
A red camisole subtly visible underneath.
Natural loose fabric folds and wrinkles.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Traditional Japanese ryokan room with tatami flooring and shoji screens.
Low wooden dining table directly in front of her.
A ceramic tokkuri of warm sake in the foreground with small Japanese dishes.
Warm intimate evening atmosphere.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Sitting on the tatami very close to the low table.
Leaning her upper body noticeably forward toward the camera.
Holding a small ceramic ochoko close toward the camera as if offering a toast.
Looking directly into the lens.
Soft slightly tipsy smile, flushed cheeks and relaxed half-lidded eyes.
Head tilted slightly to one side.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Very close-range eye-level handheld smartphone portrait.
Upper body dominates the frame.
The hand and ochoko appear slightly larger from natural wide-angle perspective.
Tokkuri visible in the lower-left foreground.
Slight natural perspective distortion.
Shallow depth of field.

LIGHTING:
Warm soft ryokan indoor lighting.
Warm amber ambient light.
Natural shadows and realistic skin tones.

DETAILS:
Candid intimate ryokan drinking moment.
Natural slightly messy hair.
Subtle skin texture and natural imperfections.
Relaxed, mildly tipsy atmosphere.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No excessive skin smoothing.
No formal sitting pose.
No distant camera.
No perfectly arranged yukata.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
